comment: Knowledge Triggers (ive-ontology-memory program). One primitive — when context matches X, bring knowledge K to bear — unifying obligations/constraints/mistakes with positive insights/strategies. kind + apply are the only knobs that differ between an obligation (block/inject at a gate) and an insight (inject at a phase). when.* reuses the matchTriggerFamilies contract.

triggers.title: A new page must be reviewed by the CMO agent
triggers.summary: Creating a marketing/landing page without CMO review ships off-brand copy. Consult the CMO persona and capture its sign-off before writing the page.

knowledge.directive: Before writing a page, invoke the CMO persona/agent and capture its sign-off.

triggers.title: A disabled render-cache flag silently tanks page performance
triggers.summary: Hit before: a config flag defaulting off disabled the render cache, so pages looked slow for no obvious reason. When investigating page performance, check the render-cache flag first before deep profiling.

knowledge.directive: Check the render-cache config flag before deep-diving page performance.

triggers.title: Planner dogfood incidents require a truth packet first
triggers.summary: When operator language says the planner failed to use advisor, steward, ontology, invariant verification, user stories, North Star, or other dogfood surfaces, measure the disagreement before normal continuation.

knowledge.directive: Before normal continuation, run the deterministic planner truth packet (`planner_truth_packet.mjs --json` or equivalent), record structured `planner_truth_packet` evidence, and carry advisor/steward, ontology/IV, story traceability, and North Star findings into the plan.
